original_batch.notes: Yamamoto-first discovery pass under the current durable repository authority. docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md were reread from main before any searching or grading. Fresh Tsuyoshi Yamamoto checks covered Jazz House ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, current schedule traces, Space M&A leads, and credible Japanese-jazz sources; surfaced Yamamoto dates were already represented in canonical/curated/processed-visible intake, so no duplicate Yamamoto event was created. Repository searches for Eva Ayllon, Eva Ayllón, Daniela Darcourt, Reunion Tour, the October 30 NJPAC date, and the November 1 Howard Theatre date returned no matching RADAR event before publication. Stage 1 admits the Newark and Washington performances because this 2026 U.S. tour places Eva Ayllón's more-than-five-decade Afro-Peruvian/landó lineage beside Daniela Darcourt's contemporary Peruvian salsa voice, creating a concrete cross-generational Peruvian music context rather than relying on fame or venue prestige. The tour's own U.S. site frames the run as a celebration of Ayllón's 55-year career. Stage 2 assigns A+ to both dates: the living-master lineage, special-guest pairing and anniversary-tour context are actively worth making room for, while the multi-city U.S. itinerary — including Newark and Washington only two days apart — makes S-tier scarcity inappropriate. Recent/current visible curated intake remains centered on A and A+ with scarcity tiers uncommon; this batch proposes A 0 / A+ 2 / S 0 / S+ 0 and does not use distribution as a quota.

events.factual_description: New Jersey Performing Arts Center presents Eva Ayllón with special guest Daniela Darcourt on Friday, October 30, 2026 at 8:00 PM in Prudential Hall on the Betty Wold Johnson Stage. NJPAC bills the event as the Reunion Tour and describes Ayllón as the Queen of Landó and a legend of Afro-Peruvian music for more than 50 years; it also notes her 2019 Latin GRAMMY Lifetime Achievement Award. NJPAC identifies Darcourt as a Latin GRAMMY-nominated artist bringing contemporary Peruvian salsa to the program. The Eva y Daniela USA 2026 tour site frames the broader run as a celebration of Ayllón's 55-year career and documents a multi-city U.S. itinerary with the same special-guest pairing, including a Washington, DC date two days later.

enrichment.note: NJPAC and its linked Ticketmaster destination verify the exact date, 8:00 PM start, Prudential Hall venue and two-artist billing. The tour site supplies the 55-year-career and multi-city U.S.-tour context. No backing-band personnel, face-value price range or exact Apple Music destination is stored without verification.

en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for the Howard Theatre date if November 1 is open. For the DMV this is the geographically natural stop on the tour, and it removes any reason to chase the same pairing to Newark unless New York/New Jersey is already part of another plan.

es.why_it_matters: La fecha de Washington pone en el mismo escenario a una voz fundacional de la música afroperuana y a una cantante contemporánea de salsa peruana dentro de una gira de aniversario. El hilo está en el contraste y la continuidad: el legado de Ayllón, con el landó al centro, encontrándose con el vocabulario salsero actual de Darcourt y llevando el ritmo peruano de una generación a otra.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 1 de noviembre está libre, sí le haría espacio activamente a la fecha del Howard Theatre. Para el DMV ésta es la parada geográficamente natural de la gira y elimina cualquier necesidad de perseguir la misma dupla hasta Newark, salvo que Nueva York/Nueva Jersey ya formen parte de otro plan.
